description: Labelled corpus for deterministic conflict/duplicate detection. Synthetic and public-safe. This is co-written regression coverage, not an independent precision measurement: the authors wrote the cases and the detector together. 'split' is a fixed flag: tune cases may be used to adjust heuristics, held-out cases are only measured. The later held-out additions (false positives found after the first version) were written together with their fixes, so they are held-out by label only. 'expect' (positive cases) is the pair, rule and confidence the finding must have; 'forbid' lists finding kinds that must not appear (medium or higher).
